bro.text: Penregon survives the Sylex Blast severely damaged, and five years later Kayla bin-Kroog rules it from the council chambers, where she accepts Tawnos's offer to build tools for rebuilding the city.

A ragged march of ten thousand Talite crusaders arrives outside the gates, and Raddic demands that Penregon drive out the machines and tear down the tower by dawn, so Kayla orders Tawnos to arm the civils and Myrel to levy the militia.
Tawnos burns his factory and vanishes, and the Talites fail to take the city from outside while hidden cultists set it ablaze, until the civils and militia drive them back.
Ten years later the harbor freezes and the world seems to be ending, so Kayla proclaims that salvation lies in the green lands to the west and leads a final caravan out of Penregon.
